comment: Independent C-first direct vomit setup. Wish solid ICE under the hero, become Black Pudding (monsters.h:2113–2123: SIZ(900,250,...), M1_BREATHLESS|M1_ACID, no AT_BREA/AD_ACID), then set the VOMITING intrinsic to one turn with the source menu's count prefix and row k. C timeout.c:vomiting_dialogue calls eat.c:vomit when Vomiting-1 reaches zero; the C-first prefix ends at that intrinsic's actual output boundary so the next turn input can be selected from the captured screen.
